pre_activation_requirements: Confirm an eligible independent human reviewer GitHub account with repository write or approved organizational reviewer permissions; reviewer must not be the PR author, last pusher, or an alias under the same human.
Replace author-only CODEOWNERS entries with the approved independent reviewer identity or eligible maintained team before requiring code-owner approval.
Review approval must be on the exact candidate HEAD; a tool-posted PR comment is not a separate authenticated human GitHub review.
Founder explicitly approves the exact ruleset/CODEOWNERS change; only then an authorized administrator applies it.
Verify enforcement using a new disposable PR, reject author-only approval, confirm catalog-integrity and required review on the last push, and maintain recovery access.
